name: cvss-my-id
description: CVSS.my.id static website, documentation, and full client-side CVSS 2.0/3.0/3.1/4.0 calculator

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@cvss/core && npm run build --workspace=@cvss/calculator && npm run build --workspace=@cvss/website && node scripts/combine-build.mjs
scripts.build:calculator: npm run build --workspace=@cvss/core && npm run build --workspace=@cvss/calculator
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspace=@cvss/core && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
